name: daily-sales-digest
description: Posts yesterday's revenue, orders, average order value and top products to Slack every morning, and calls out anything unusual against the 7-day average.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every morning at 8:00 in your time zone

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Totals yesterday's revenue, orders, AOV and top products

howItWorks.label: Compares
howItWorks.text: Each number with the previous 7-day average and explains big swings

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short digest to your Slack channel

plugins.reason: Posts the digest to your team's channel

data.description: The order's status, to leave out cancelled, test and fully refunded orders
Order line items with product and quantity, for top products
The order's currency, when the store sells in more than one

parameters.label: Time zone
parameters.description: Used for the schedule and for what counts as "yesterday"

parameters.label: Call out changes above (%)
parameters.description: A metric that differs from its 7-day average by more than this is called out
